## Description

Document contracted phase-gate suite policy; keep per-task verify scoped; prove skill↔contract consistency and red-first unchanged.

## Approach

1. Update README Testing section: rename tier-2 to phase-level suite; describe `phase_gate.suite` modes/gates; this repo full+advisory.
2. Update `tests/test_verify_budget.py` expectations for suite wording (still reject whole-suite on per-task verify_command).
3. Ensure `tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py` and close-batch/red-first tests stay green.
4. Align any remaining tier-2 strings in skills other than execute-phase if left by suite-engine.
